narrative:
Washington County has 41,260 registered voters, with 18.5% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 31.1% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 44.6%, a pronounced Democratic lean of 13.5 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 30.4% of registrants.
